title.zh: 贝莱德向SEC提交第三只比特币ETF（PBIT）申请
title.en: BlackRock files with SEC for third Bitcoin ETF (PBIT)

current_state.zh: 贝莱德向SEC提交了iShares比特币管理保护ETF（PBIT）的初步招股说明书，该基金将利用与其657亿美元现货IBIT基金挂钩的期权，以收益上限换取有限的下行保护，从而在其加密ETF产品线中新增第三只比特币相关产品，但未申请Solana或XRP敞口。
current_state.en: BlackRock filed a preliminary prospectus with the SEC for the iShares Bitcoin Managed Protection ETF (PBIT), which would use options linked to its $65.7B spot IBIT fund to offer limited downside protection in exchange for capped gains, adding a third Bitcoin-linked product to its crypto ETF lineup without filing for Solana or XRP exposure.

updates.title_zh: 贝莱德提交第三只比特币ETF申请，拟提供下行保护及IBIT上涨敞口
updates.title_en: 贝莱德提交第三只比特币ETF申请，拟提供下行保护及IBIT上涨敞口
updates.what_changed_zh: 贝莱德向美国SEC提交了iShares比特币管理保护ETF的申请文件，该基金将提供部分下行保护，同时为其旗舰IBIT比特币ETF提供有上限的上行敞口。
updates.what_changed_en: BlackRock submitted a filing with the US SEC for the iShares Bitcoin Managed Protect ETF, which would offer partial downside protection while delivering capped upside exposure to its flagship IBIT bitcoin ETF.
updates.current_state_zh: 贝莱德向美国SEC提交了iShares比特币管理保护ETF的申请文件，该基金将提供部分下行保护，同时为其旗舰IBIT比特币ETF提供有上限的上行敞口。
updates.current_state_en: BlackRock submitted a filing with the US SEC for the iShares Bitcoin Managed Protect ETF, which would offer partial downside protection while delivering capped upside exposure to its flagship IBIT bitcoin ETF.

updates.detailed_summary_en: BlackRock submitted a filing with the US SEC for the iShares Bitcoin Managed Protect ETF, which would offer partial downside protection while delivering capped upside exposure to its flagship IBIT bitcoin ETF.

updates.title_zh: 贝莱德申请“缓冲型”比特币ETF，IBIT单日吸金6.65亿美元
updates.title_en: BlackRock Files for 'Buffer' Bitcoin ETF as IBIT Draws $665M in a Day
updates.what_changed_zh: 新报道补充了该申请的细节：拟用代码PBIT，通过IBIT期权构建缓冲结构，分三批每月滚动，每批初始损失保护约10%，并依据1940年投资公司法注册；管理费尚未填写。
updates.what_changed_en: The report adds details of the same SEC filing: proposed ticker PBIT, a buffer structure using IBIT options with three overlapping monthly tranches, roughly 10% initial downside protection per tranche, registration under the Investment Company Act of 1940, and an unfilled management fee.
updates.current_state_zh: 贝莱德已向美国SEC提交iShares Bitcoin Managed Protection ETF（拟用代码PBIT）的申请，该缓冲型ETF拟通过IBIT期权提供约10%的下行保护并限制上涨空间；申请仍处于待SEC审查阶段，尚未获批或推出。
updates.current_state_en: BlackRock has filed with the US SEC for the iShares Bitcoin Managed Protection ETF (proposed ticker PBIT), a buffer ETF using IBIT options to provide roughly 10% downside protection while capping upside; the filing remains pending SEC review and has not been approved or launched.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: BlackRock filed for the iShares Bitcoin Managed Protection ETF (PBIT), which would use options on IBIT to cap gains while limiting losses, as IBIT recorded $665.2 million in net inflows on Monday.
updates.detailed_summary_en: BlackRock filed for the iShares Bitcoin Managed Protection ETF (PBIT), which would use options on IBIT to cap gains while limiting losses, as IBIT recorded $665.2 million in net inflows on Monday.
